messages:
mari (docs): Tiny PR to fix a code example failed to auto-merge. it says 2 required reviewers still pending. anyone set up an exemption?
zane (eng): GH can't change required review counts by path. we use a bot that posts an approval for docs-only PRs.
mari (docs): do we have a template or action already?
tyler (infra): not yet in this repo. pattern we follow elsewhere: detect docs-only, run markdown lint + linkcheck, if green the bot posts a review approval and a comment listing files. then auto-merge can proceed.
auto-merge-bot: note: auto-merge respects branch protection 1mdash; all required status checks must be green and there must be no outstanding review requests.
mari (docs): can we exclude sensitive folders like /legal or /security?
tyler (infra): yes, workflow will bail out if changed files touch those paths and ask for human review.
nora (legal): please make sure bot approvals are auditable and include a link to changed files in the comment.\zmari (docs): typo: that was me, not zmari. ;)
tyler (infra): I'll draft a GH Action and a CODEOWNERS line for @redwood-docs, plus a PR template asking authors to add [docs] prefix or the docs-only label. aiming to open draft today.
mari (docs): thanks — will test with a dummy link-fix after it's up.
